svg.title: Generated travel site — desktop layout
svg.desc: A figure, not a screenshot. Vector rendering of the site design system in reference/site-layout-spec.md sections 1-3 (typography, colour architecture, component catalog) laid out per section 4 Desktop, drawn against the tracked synthetic fixture in this directory. Every name, date, time, event ID, venue key, booking posture and count shown here is taken verbatim from a file in examples/data-architecture-demo/; nothing is invented. The per-trip accent is an azulejo blue, chosen at site-build time as CLAUDE.md's Design Principles describe. The map panel is schematic — pin positions are not geographic, and no tile layer is drawn because CartoDB tiles are CDN-loaded. Committed as source: edit this file directly; there is no build step and no capture step.
